intro.readOnly: Read-only view of the registration you submitted. Edits are not possible while Transport Authority has the case.
intro.resubmission: Update the details below and resubmit the registration. New signing links will be sent to every co-owner.
intro.default: Owner form — fill in your details, choose the vehicle you are registering, and list any co-owners that must sign before the case goes to Transport Authority.

idDocument.label: Owner ID document (required)
idDocument.hint: ID card, passport, or driving licence. PDF, JPEG, or PNG up to 10 MB. The Transport Authority reviewer will be able to download this file.
idDocument.dropLabel: Drop your ID document here, or click to choose

coOwners.hint: Each co-owner gets an email with a link to approve or reject the vehicle registration. Once all co-owners sign, any owner can click "Send to Transport Authority" to forward the case for review. Leave empty if you are the sole owner.

errors.namesRequired: First name and last name are required.
errors.ageRange: Age must be a whole number between 1 and 130.
errors.vehicleRequired: Please choose a vehicle from the registry.
errors.idDocumentRequired: Please upload a copy of your ID card or passport.
errors.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address, or leave the field blank.
errors.applicantEmailRequiredWithCoOwners: Your own email is required when adding co-owners — we send you a tracking link.
errors.coOwnerEmailInvalid: Co-owner "{{name}}" needs a valid email address.
errors.duplicateCoOwnerEmail: Two co-owners share the email "{{email}}". Each owner needs a unique address.
errors.applicantEmailInCoOwners: Your own email cannot also appear in the co-owner list — the applicant is already counted as an owner.
errors.registryLoadFailed: Could not load the vehicle registry: {{message}}
